title: OpenAI partners with Microsoft, AMD, Broadcom, Nvidia, and Intel researchers to detail the Multipath Reliable Connection (MRC) protocol to help scale compute (Nat Rubio-Licht/The Deep View)
summary: Nat Rubio-Licht / The Deep View: OpenAI partners with Microsoft, AMD, Broadcom, Nvidia, and Intel researchers to detail the Multipath Reliable Connection (MRC) protocol to help scale compute — OpenAI is getting creative to deal with the industry's imminent compute crunch. … The protocol, which has been in the works for two years …
